referral_code.description: The code a person's invite to yaks.app carries: whoever signs up sending it was invited by them. Minted the first time their invite page opens; unique, so a code names one person.

referral.description: One person who signed up for yaks.app through another's invite: who invited them. A person is invited once, by whoever's code their first message carried; its `created` stamp is when.
referral.$comment: referral.ts `credit`. Its eid is derived from the invitee, which is what makes a person invited once.

rewarded.description: The free month of the Plus plan a referral gave its inviter's space when the invitee built their first app. A mark, written once.

until.description: The day that space's free time now runs through.

subscription.description: For a space already paying, the provider's subscription whose next charge moved a month later.

comped.description: The Plus plan given to a space free, through `until`, with nothing billed for it. Each reward adds a month after the later of now and the free time it already had.

plan_trial.description: A space's 30-day trial of the Plus plan, whose clock stops while its owners are away. Running, paused or ended is computed from its properties. The platform writes it.

through.description: The day it ends, moved later by each time its owners were away.

paused.description: When its clock stopped; none while it runs.

subscribed.description: When the space subscribed during it, which gave the early credit once.

told.description: The notes its owners were sent, by key.

reward_referral.description: give an invitee's inviter a free month of the Plus plan when the invitee builds their first app
reward_referral.$comment: An app made in a space whose owner was invited gives their inviter the month, the first time (facets/directory-effects.ts).

chat_dm.description: A direct message to the platform bot, kept for up to seven days while it waits for its sender’s Operator. A receipt prevents a Gateway replay from taking it twice.

chat_dm_arrived.description: carry a direct message to the sender’s Operator or offer to link their account

chat_linked.description: re-read what a chat account's guest raised as its person's once they link it, so a request within their role goes on without waiting for anyone
chat_linked.$comment: A person's own chat account linked: what its guest raised before is re-read as theirs in each space they sit in (chat.ts `linkedNow`).

support_reply.description: carry the platform's answer in a support thread to the person's Updates and to the Operator conversation or connector agent it came from, until each takes it
support_reply.$comment: The platform's answer in a support thread, or its completion, carried to the thread's person (support-reply.ts).
